## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Be [...]
I’m using the `how` skill to trace the lint subsystem from configuration through diagnostics and exit status. I’ll inspect the source and tests without changing files.

command:
if [ -d .gitnexus ]; then printf '%s\n' yes; else printf '%s\n' no; fi
rg --files dev/lint .github | sort
rg -n "custom_lint|lint_no_debugger|suppression|suppress|per-file|per_file|debugger|no-debugger|no_debugger" . --glob '!**/.git/**'

git status --short
nl -ba dev/lint/custom_lint.py
nl -ba dev/lint/_framework.py
for f in dev/lint/lint_*.py; do printf '\nFILE %s\n' "$f"; nl -ba "$f"; done

rg -n "dev\.lint|dev/lint|custom-lint|lint_workspace_scoped_cache|lint_session_list_visibility|lint_no_global_asyncio_patch|lint_no_hardcoded_models|lint_no_skipped_tests|lint_pnpm_override_consistency" pyproject.toml .pre-commit-config.yaml Justfile tests dev --glob '*.py' --glob '*.toml' --glob '*.yaml' --glob '*.yml' --glob 'Justfile' --glob '!dev/lint/*.py'
rg --files | rg '(^|/)(test.*lint|lint.*test|custom_lint)'

nl -ba .pre-commit-config.yaml | sed -n '1,110p'
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_custom_lint.py
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_framework.py
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_lint_workspace_scoped_cache.py
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_lint_session_list_visibility.py

nl -ba dev/lint/lint_no_skipped_tests.py
nl -ba dev/lint/lint_no_hardcoded_models.py
nl -ba dev/lint/lint_pnpm_override_consistency.py
nl -ba .github/workflows/lint.yml | sed -n '1,220p'
rg -n "pytest.*tests/dev/lint|tests/dev/lint|custom-lint|pre-commit" pyproject.toml Justfile justfile .github/workflows/lint.yml CONTRIBUTING.md 2>/dev/null

content.text: The repository has two lint generations: older hooks receive pre-commit’s file arguments, while the aggregate runner invokes registered zero-argument rules that choose their own tracked-file scope. I’m checking both contracts because the requested `python -m` command needs to preserve the older per- [...]

command:
rg -n "\bbreakpoint\s*\(|\b(?:pdb|ipdb|pudb|debugpy)\.set_trace\s*\(|from (?:pdb|ipdb|pudb) import set_trace|import (?:pdb|ipdb|pudb|debugpy)" --glob '*.py' .
rg -n "no debugger|no-debugger|debugger lint|lint_no_debugger" CHANGELOG.md CONTRIBUTING.md docs dev tests .github pyproject.toml 2>/dev/null
git log --all --oneline -- dev/lint/custom_lint.py dev/lint/_framework.py | head -30
git branch --all --no-color | sed -n '1,80p'

nl -ba CONTRIBUTING.md | sed -n '120,165p'
nl -ba dev/lint/__init__.py
rg -n "git ls-files" dev/lint tests/dev/lint
rg -n "RULE_NAME|def check\(|def check_paths|def main" dev/lint/*.py

nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_lint_no_global_asyncio_patch.py
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_lint_no_skipped_tests.py
nl -ba tests/dev/lint/test_lint_no_hardcoded_models.py | sed -n '1,330p'
find dev tests/dev/lint -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -print

nl -ba dev/lint/lint_session_list_visibility.py | sed -n '1,230p'
nl -ba dev/lint/session_list_visibility.mjs | sed -n '1,260p'

nl -ba dev/lint/session_list_visibility.mjs | tail -80
nl -ba dev/lint/session_list_visibility.test.mjs | sed -n '1,260p'

git remote -v
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
git log -1 --format='%H%n%P%n%s%n%b'

if [ -d /run/sandbox/source ]; then rg -n "lint_no_debugger|no-debugger" /run/sandbox/source --glob '!**/.git/**' 2>/dev/null | head -100; fi
find /run/sandbox/source -path '*/dev/lint/lint_no_debugger.py' -o -path '*/tests/dev/lint/test_lint_no_debugger.py' 2>/dev/null | head -20
